# SentryNode Gateway — Full Reference

## What It Is

SentryNode Gateway is a semantic AI inference governance and FinOps platform. It sits between enterprise applications and model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Google Gemini, etc.) and enforces intelligent routing, hard budget guardrails, and cryptographic audit trails on every inference request.

Built by Neha Dangwal (9 years enterprise engineering at Cisco, Senior SWE / Platform Product Owner, and Dell EMC). MS Computer Science. U.S. Patent Pending #63/982,542, filed February 13, 2026. Apache 2.0 open core with enterprise proprietary extensions.

## The Problem It Solves

The "AI Tax": an estimated 80% of enterprise AI spend is wasted when frontier models handle routine low-complexity tasks, or when autonomous agents spiral into recursive loops that exhaust cloud budgets in minutes. SentryNode addresses both problems simultaneously.

## Validated Benchmarks

From a 1,000-request stress test across mixed complexity and adversarial inputs:

- Cost per 1,000 requests (direct to frontier model): $5.00
- Cost per 1,000 requests (through SentryNode Gateway): $1.12
- Cost reduction: 77.6%
- SLM offload rate: 80% of requests
- Semantic quality parity maintained: 98.2%
- Agentic loop interception rate: 100%
- Agentic loop interception latency: under 40ms
- Voice pipeline end-to-end latency: approximately 2.8 seconds

## Core Capabilities

Adaptive Inference Routing: scores each request's semantic complexity in real time and routes to the most cost-effective model capable of handling it, reserving frontier models only for genuinely complex tasks.

Semantic Circuit Breakers: detects and intercepts runaway agentic loops — recursive patterns where autonomous agents re-invoke themselves without progress — in under 40ms, before they exhaust budget.

Budget Guardrails: enforces hard spend caps per tenant, per application, or organization-wide. Supports per-tenant chargeback reporting for multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

Shadow Mode Validation: runs requests through both a smaller model and a frontier model in parallel, comparing quality, to build confidence before fully offloading a task class to the cheaper model.

Sovereign Ledger: HMAC-SHA256 cryptographic signature on every inference request, creating an immutable audit trail. Designed for regulated industries requiring AI request provenance.

Voice Layer Governance: observability and cost control for STT-to-LLM-to-TTS pipelines (Deepgram + Gemini / Groq). Latency breakdown: STT 340ms, LLM 1.2s, TTS 1.3s.

PII Scrubbing, Kill Switch Controls, gVisor-hardened execution sidecars.

## Who It Is For

- FinTech and banking: agentic compliance workflows running 10,000+ document reviews per day
- Enterprise SaaS: per-tenant AI budget enforcement and chargeback for multi-tenant platforms
- DevOps and platform engineering: autonomous code agent governance and circuit-breaker controls
- Voice agent builders: STT-to-LLM-to-TTS pipeline cost control and observability

## Technical Stack

Python, LiteLLM, Redis, Docker, PyArmor obfuscation for proprietary modules, Streamlit admin dashboard, async streaming. Deployment via Docker Compose.
